hero.heading: UISD Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: UISD students start Aug. 12, 2026. Winter Break runs Dec. 17–Jan. 5, Spring Break is Mar. 8–12, and the last day is May 26, 2027.
hero.desktopDescription: UISD’s 2026-2027 calendar has 174 instructional days. Classes begin Aug. 12, 2026, and end May 26, 2027. Winter Break is Dec. 17–Jan. 5. Oct. 9 and Mar. 29 may become weather make-up days; high school students have early release Dec. 16 and May 26.

editorialSummary.heading: UISD 2026-2027 calendar highlights
highlights: A Wednesday, August 12 start and Wednesday, May 26 finish
Winter Break runs continuously from December 17 through January 5
October 9 and March 29 can become attendance days after bad weather
paragraphs: United ISD’s 2026-2027 school year has 174 instructional days. Students start Wednesday, Aug. 12, 2026, and the last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Thanksgiving Break is Nov. 23–27, Winter Break runs Dec. 17–Jan. 5, and Spring Break is Mar. 8–12.

Two dates need extra attention: Oct. 9 and Mar. 29 are scheduled student days off but are also reserved as bad-weather make-up days. The Feb. 19 WBCA Friday student holiday and Feb. 22 Presidents’ Day create a four-day weekend. High school students have early release Dec. 16 and May 26; the published calendar does not list an early-release time.

UISD lists EOC testing on Dec. 2, 3 and 8, with additional STAAR and EOC testing dates in April. L. B. Johnson and John B. Alexander graduations are May 26; United South and United High graduations are May 27. Those four high school ceremonies are at SAMES Arena, while the Cherish Center ceremony will be held at SAC Auditorium.

comparativeInsights: October 9 is normally a professional-development and PLC day but may become a required weather make-up day.
Winter Break includes the December 17 and January 5 teacher workdays, so students return January 6.
February 19 and February 22 create one continuous four-day student weekend.
March 29 is not stored as a guaranteed holiday because the PDF also reserves it for bad-weather make-up instruction.
Memorial Day falls after the May 26 last day and is therefore not stored as a school-year closure.

about.dataSource: This page uses United ISD’s official 2026-2027 English academic calendar PDF, revised June 17, 2026, the calendar image linked on the same district page, and the district’s Academic Calendar page. The district page confirms the first and last days, continuous Winter Break, named holidays, and graduation schedule.
about.processing: Only events that directly affect students are stored. Pre-year employee orientation, staff preparation before the first day, and the May 27 teacher workday are excluded. Testing and graduations remain because they affect specific students and families. December EOC dates were checked in both the current English PDF and calendar image: U.S. History and Biology are December 2, Algebra I is December 3, and English I and II are December 8. The Cherish Center venue is included in prose and FAQs only, because no ceremony date or time is published on the calendar page.
about.updates: October 9 and March 29 are conditional attendance dates: the academic calendar marks them with the bad-weather make-up symbol. The baseline no-school flags describe the current schedule, not a guarantee that students will never attend. Check district announcements about use of either date.
about.disclaimer: This independent calendar reference is not operated by United ISD. Families should confirm test assignments, early-release times, transportation, graduation admission, weather make-up decisions, and campus-specific activities through official district or school messages.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for UISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of classes is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for UISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The final student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. High school students are released early that day.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are in UISD’s 2026-2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists 174 instructional days: 83 in the first semester and 91 in the second semester.

faqs.question: Do UISD students have school on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. UISD students are off Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Is October 9, 2026, a guaranteed day off for UISD students?
faqs.answer: No. October 9 is normally used for professional development and PLC work, but it is also reserved as a bad-weather make-up day.

faqs.question: Do UISD students have school on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12, is the district's Columbus Day and Indigenous Peoples' Day holiday.

faqs.question: Does UISD have school on Election Day 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tuesday, November 3, is a regular instructional day on the 2026-2027 academic calendar.

faqs.question: When is UISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is UISD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs continuously from Thursday, December 17, 2026, through Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

faqs.question: When do UISD students return after Winter Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Classes resume Wednesday, January 6, 2027, which is also the first day of the second semester.

faqs.question: Why are December 17 and January 5 included in UISD Winter Break?
faqs.answer: December 17 and January 5 are teacher workdays. United ISD lists December 17–January 5 as one continuous student Winter Break, with classes resuming January 6.

faqs.question: Does UISD have a four-day weekend in February 2027?
faqs.answer: Students are off February 19 for the WBCA Friday holiday and February 22 for Presidents' Day, creating a four-day weekend.

faqs.question: When is UISD’s WBCA Friday student holiday in 2027?
faqs.answer: The WBCA Friday Student Holiday is February 19, 2027. Students are also off Monday, February 22, for Presidents’ Day.

faqs.question: Do UISD students have school on Presidents’ Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. UISD students are off Monday, February 22, 2027, for Presidents’ Day.

faqs.question: When is UISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 8-12, 2027. Students return to class Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Do UISD students have school on Good Friday 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 26, is a student day off for professional development. United ISD’s calendar page also identifies it as Good Friday.

faqs.question: Is Easter Monday 2027 a guaranteed day off for UISD students?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, March 29, is scheduled as Easter Monday but is also reserved as a bad-weather make-up day.

faqs.question: Do UISD students have school on April 30, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. April 30 is a professional-development and PLC day, so students do not attend classes.

faqs.question: When are UISD high school early-release days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: High school students have early release December 16, 2026, and May 26, 2027. The academic calendar does not publish dismissal times.

faqs.question: Are UISD elementary and middle school early-release dates published for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: No elementary or middle school early-release dates are marked on the 2026-2027 academic calendar. Check your campus communications for any school-specific schedule changes.

faqs.question: What are the UISD nine-week grading periods for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: They run August 12-October 8, October 13-December 16, January 6-March 19, and March 22-May 26.

faqs.question: When do UISD six-week grading periods end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The six periods end September 18, October 30, December 16, February 18, April 9, and May 26.

faqs.question: When are UISD STAAR/EOC tests in December 2026?
faqs.answer: U.S. History and Biology are scheduled for Dec. 2. Algebra I is scheduled for Dec. 3, and English I and English II are scheduled for Dec. 8.

faqs.question: What STAAR dates are listed for UISD in April 2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists grade- and subject-specific testing on April 7, 8, 13, 14, 20, 21, 22, 27 and 28. April 13 includes English I and II EOC exams; April 21 includes Biology and U.S. History EOC exams; April 28 includes Algebra I.

faqs.question: Do all UISD students test on every listed STAAR date?
faqs.answer: No. Each date applies only to the grades, subjects, or end-of-course groups named on the calendar.

faqs.question: When is UISD L. B. Johnson High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: L. B. Johnson High School graduation is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, at 9:00 a.m. at SAMES Arena.

faqs.question: When is UISD John B. Alexander High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: John B. Alexander High School graduation is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, at 2:00 p.m. at SAMES Arena.

faqs.question: When is UISD United South High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: United South High School graduation is Thursday, May 27, 2027, at 9:00 a.m. at SAMES Arena.

faqs.question: When is UISD United High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: United High School graduation is Thursday, May 27, 2027, at 2:00 p.m. at SAMES Arena.

faqs.question: Does UISD have school on Memorial Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. UISD’s 2026-2027 school year ends May 26, five days before Memorial Day on May 31.

faqs.question: Which dates are UISD bad-weather make-up days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Oct. 9, 2026, and Mar. 29, 2027, are reserved as bad-weather make-up days. Both are scheduled as student days off unless UISD activates them to replace lost instructional time.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official UISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: United ISD publishes its current 2026-2027 calendar on the district’s Academic Calendar page, with both English and Spanish versions available.

faqs.question: Is the UISD 2026-2027 calendar available in Spanish?
faqs.answer: Yes. United ISD’s Academic Calendar page links English and Spanish versions of the 2026-2027 calendar.

faqs.question: Where is the UISD Cherish Center graduation held?
faqs.answer: United ISD’s calendar page says the Cherish Center graduation ceremony will be held at SAC Auditorium. The page does not list a date or time.

statistics.label: Student attendance days
statistics.explanation: The PDF lists 83 first-semester days and 91 second-semester days.

statistics.label: Total no-school weekdays
statistics.explanation: Counted from published no-class events between the first and last student days. Weekends and shortened school days are excluded, and overlapping events count once.

statistics.label: Student no-school days
statistics.explanation: Counts weekdays represented by NON_STUDENT_DAY events, including staff professional-learning and exchange days. Named holidays and official school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Listed early-release dates
statistics.explanation: Counted from official early-release entries; some dates apply only to the grades or campuses named in the calendar.

statistics.label: Longest listed break
statistics.explanation: Dec 17, 2026–Jan 5, 2027, including weekends. The stretch contains 14 confirmed no-school weekdays.

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.
